description: The line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after being pruned at 70% sparsity using the OWL method with varying values of M. The x-axis represents the parameter M, ranging from 3 to 8 in integer steps, while the y-axis shows the perplexity, with values ranging from approximately 18 to 41. The green line, representing LLaMA1-7B, starts at a perplexity of about 28.2 when M=3, decreases to around 24.8 at M=5, and then gradually increases to approximately 36.1 at M=8. The orange line for LLaMA1-13B begins at a perplexity of about 19.6 at M=3, decreases to around 16.9 at M=5, and then rises to approximately 20.3 at M=8. The blue line for Vicuna-7B starts at a perplexity of about 40.8 at M=3, decreases to around 34.2 at M=5, and then slightly increases to approximately 39.5 at M=8. Overall, the plot shows that the perplexity of all models generally decreases as M increases from 3 to 5, after which it tends to increase again.
